notes.1: This was a straightforward question in which items 1 and 4 required an entry to be made in the general journal in respect of them. Had item 3 been the taking of goods for own use by the owner then that would have required a journal entry. However, taking cash is not usually recorded in the general journal.
notes.20: Candidates lacked clarity on cost behaviour with changes in volume. Variable costs per unit are unchanged with a change in the level of production. However, total fixed costs are likely to increase as production levels increase (stepped costs) and they will always change per unit as more (or less) is produced. Thus the two correct statements were 1 and 3, giving the key B. �PAGE�4
notes.25: The calculation of margin of safety as a percentage is the contribution above the break-even point divided by the total contribution. In this case $(108 000/288 000), giving 37.50 per cent. �PAGE�5
